title: Extend Cli with Hooks and Configure
prompt: Implement hook command (git hooks: commit.starting/ended; agent hooks: agent.starting/ended, prompt.submit, compacting, tool.calling/ended, code.reading/edited, notification) and configure command that auto-configures pre-commit and agent hook configs for all supported clients. Remove old husky setup. Implement tool call blocking (deny git checkout/stash).
summary: Added Input json.RawMessage to HookContext; hookCommand reads piped stdin (skips terminals) and stores the full client JSON payload. logHook includes it in the log entry. Added TestHookLoggingStdinInput. All 23 hook tests pass.
